items.quote: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father
items.claim: Isaac re-dug wells that had been originally dug during Abraham's lifetime

items.quote: for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham
items.claim: The Philistines physically blocked or filled the wells at a point after Abraham's death

items.quote: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them
items.claim: Isaac preserved the original names Abraham had given to the wells
